handle_layout: The probe creates a real C++ object implementing the exact fixed IVlm interface, explicitly upcasts GrammarBackend* to IVlm*, then reinterprets only that base pointer as the SDK opaque geniex_VLM*. The official wrapper reinterprets it back to IVlm* before virtual dispatch. No assumed offset or fabricated vtable is used.
generate_preconditions: The complete fixed geniex_vlm_generate source checks only the non-null backend pointer, then invokes the IVlm virtual generate. It does not look up the handle in a registry or require a create/init token. The diagnostic supplies real live object storage and non-null zero-initialized input/output structures. No SDK init/model create/plugin discovery is called.
limits: The fake backend is a test double for exception propagation only. A successful diagnostic does not qualify model generation, QNN, production handles, or UI actions.
